class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, n=0, m=None, a=None):
        if m is None:
            m = n
        self.h = n
        self.w = m
        if a is None:
            self.a = [0] * (n * m)
        else:
            self.a = a

    def get(self, r, c):
        return self.a[r * self.w + c]

    def set(self, r, c, value):
        self.a[r * self.w + c] = value

    def __iadd__(self, m):
        assert self.h == m.h and self.w == m.w
        for i in range(self.h * self.w):
            self.a[i] += m.a[i]
        return self

    def __isub__(self, m):
        assert self.h == m.h and self.w == m.w
        for i in range(self.h * self.w):
            self.a[i] -= m.a[i]
        return self

    def __imul__(self, m):
        assert self.w == m.h
        ret = Matrix(self.h, m.w)
        for i in range(self.h):

                s = 0

                    s += self.get(i, k) * m.get(k, j)
                ret.set(i, j, s % mod)
        self.h, self.w, self.a = ret.h, ret.w, ret.a
        return self

    def __add__(self, m):

        res += m
        return res

    def __sub__(self, m):
        res = Matrix(self.h, self.w, self.a.copy())
        res -= m
        return res

    def __mul__(self, m):
        res = Matrix(self.h, m.w)
        for i in range(self.h):
            for j in range(m.w):
                s = 0
                for k in range(self.w):
                    s += self.get(i, k) * m.get(k, j)
                res.set(i, j, s % mod)
        return res

def unit(n):
    res = Matrix(n)
    for i in range(n):
        res.set(i, i, 1)
    return res

def matpow(a, n):
    assert a.h == a.w
    ret = unit(a.h)
    while n:
        if n & 1:
            ret *= a
        a *= a
        n >>= 1
    return ret
